name: Fury Witch Patron
body:
In Italian culture, Megaira’s name (“megera”) is synonymous of “hag” and “witch”, taking the meaning of “ugly old woman”. Hags and witches can turn to the General of Furies to grant them powers.

2nd—interrogation, 4th—sense fear, 6th—rage, 8th—fear, 10th—nightmare, 12th—cruel jaunt, 14th—insanity, 16th—phantasmal revenge, 18th—weird.
